name: What kind of warranty comes with a Zen Tiny Home?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty comes with a Zen Tiny Home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zen Tiny Homes provides a one-year limited warranty covering structural and craftsmanship defects, with options to extend coverage on select components.
